na9fb4f9db3.headline: Jolla: Sailfish OS in Russia as an alternative to Android
na9fb4f9db3.summary: The Russian government has selected Sailfish OS from Finnish company Jolla as the basis for its official mobile operating system, positioning it as an alternative to Android.
na9fb4f9db3.why: Government adoption of alternative mobile OS reflects strategic moves to reduce dependency on foreign technology platforms, impacting the local tech ecosystem and security policies.
